name: 72753 · Prairie Grove, AR
findings: ZIP 72753 (Prairie Grove) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72753 (Prairie Grove) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
